title: [security] Stored-metadata-body family: a formula field's one-hop read through a reference is an exit the family projection does not reach — reach not yet measured, detail withheld pending maintainer
body:
Filing-gate category ①, under its exception for a possible data leak: reach is **not yet measured**, and measuring it is the first act on this card. `finding` class a.

- **Reader who acts:** triage grades this and sets its lane. The fix would land at the shared one-hop read (`packages/objectql`, `domain:engine`) and at the lint's one-hop rule (`packages/lint`, `domain:devx`). Once it is graded, `domain:engine` seat 1 (seat post #6367) dispatches it, measurement first.
- **Dedupe:** two semantic searches over this repository's issues, closed included, found no card for this position:
  - "formula field lookup to sys_metadata reads stored metadata body credential through one hop traversal not redacted": 12 hits;
  - "stored metadata body family reference lookup traversal redaction bypass formula relationship": 2 hits.

  The nearest are #21120 (the family closeout), #21207 (two further exits) and #7990 (the family's origin).

⚠️ **Security card:** category and position only. No request, field path or value is written here. The filing seat keeps the detail out of GitHub and gives it to the maintainer directly.

## Source

The `TIER_DEFAULT` contract review of PR #24307 (#24197 part 2) escalated this at head `0d133459d7`. It is item ③.6 of that PR's record. The PR's dev noted it out of scope in report 6248949940. It was read in code only. ⛔ It has not been measured.

## Position (read in code on `main`)

- **The hop.** PR #24274 (`d537a318b`) gave the formula read path one hop: `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`, `resolveOneHopRelated` under the caller's authority, reached from `resolveFormulaRelated`. The hop is an ordinary engine `find`.
- **The projection.** The family's projection is applied at the doors and at the reader-context seam, "never at the engine" (the header of `packages/runtime/src/stored-metadata-reader-seam.ts`). The data door applies it only when the requested object is itself a family object (`STORED_METADATA_BODY_OBJECTS`).
- **The admission.** No refusal of a traversal into a family object was found in `packages/lint` or `packages/formula`.
- **Exits:**
  - a data read of an object that declares such a formula;
  - after PR #24307 lands, a hook body's `ctx.title()`. The body api's family-read refusal does not cover a title formula's hop. That adds nothing new: the same value reaches a body today through a `ctx.api.object(OBJECT)` read of that object.
- **The pin.** The family's enumeration pin, `packages/metadata-protocol/src/stored-metadata-body-family.pin.test.ts`, names no formula hop.

## Reach to measure first

- **Readers.** The hop is read under the reader's own permissions, so only a reader whose own read returns a family row receives anything. Measure which roles those are.
- **Producers.** Measure whether a save door today accepts a reference into a family object together with a formula that reads through it.
- **Disclosure.** Measure whether the hop serves a reader anything the family's own door withholds from that same reader.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

Refuse a traversal into a family object at the shared hop and at the lint's one-hop rule, as the family refuses elsewhere, and add the hop to the family's enumeration pin. ⛔ No second projection.
